# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Pharaoh Blesses the Marriage; Jacob Comes

---

**1** Around this time Pharaoh sent word to Joseph: 'Come to me immediately. The daughter of Potiphera the priest of Heliopolis has been pledged to you. She is a virgin, untouched by any man. Her name is Aseneth, and she will be your wife.'

**2** Joseph went to Pharaoh and stood before him. Pharaoh saw him, was overjoyed, and kissed him on the mouth.

**3** Pharaoh summoned Pentephres: 'Bring your daughter Aseneth to me.' Pentephres came with Aseneth and presented her before Pharaoh.

**4** Pharaoh saw Aseneth and was struck by her beauty. He said: 'Blessed is the Lord God of Joseph who chose you for him. You are beautiful and good and a holy virgin. Joseph is mighty — wise and powerful. I am pledging you to him today, and he will be your husband forever.'

**5** Pharaoh placed golden crowns on both their heads, joined their right hands, and said: 'May the Lord God Most High bless you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and glorify you forever and ever.'

**6** He said: 'Go to your chambers.' Joseph and Aseneth went in together, and they feasted and drank wine.

**7** Joseph was with Aseneth, and she conceived and gave birth to Manasseh and his brother Ephraim in Joseph's house.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
